title: Approval queue pattern — Example Design System
problem: Operators must find the few items blocked on them among hundreds of finished ones
observed: The queue lists only items waiting on the viewer, each row names the decision and the blocking reason; finished items are behind a tab with a count.

adopt.pattern: Rows name the decision needed, not just the status
adopt.why: Answers Q1 without opening the item
